text:
maria: quick follow-up from RFC 1 ingest->fanout contract discussion. main goals: deterministic billing, avoid thundering backfills, and clear repair semantics.

raj: agree. ingest = canonical. fanout reads canonical stream and emits billing events. corrections must be explicit repair events referencing origin_ingest_id.

oliver: two options: strong fanout ordering per-tenant vs eventual + idempotent ledger. strong ordering adds cross-shard coord. I prefer eventual + idempotent ledger.

maria: same. define idempotency key and reconciliation behavior so ledger can collapse duplicates.

jamie: propose event fields: origin_ingest_id, event_version, provenance_fps, tokens, repair_flag, backfill_flag, origin_region, fanout_region. sample: `{"tenant":"t42","origin_ingest_id":"ing-0001","tokens":120}`

raj: add fanout_node_id+seq for replay detection. ledger key = origin_ingest_id + billing_window. repairs upsert that key.

oliver: persistent dedupe markers are required to survive crashes. compacted topic or small per-tenant KV with TTL (default 72h) seems right. cost vs correctness tradeoff.

maria: SLA: fast-path sync attempt within 30s, async allowed for repairs/backfills. surface p95 delivery, retry count, repairs-applied-within-ttl.

jamie: fanout config sketch: `delivery_slo_s:30, max_retries:5, dedupe_mem_s:3600, marker_ttl_s:259200`

raj: backfills should be `backfill:true` and rate-limited; they shouldn't count against normal SLAs. also include backfill_origin and operator_id.

oliver: cross-region: preserve origin_region; fallback policy: permissive for non-SLA tenants, strict for enterprise (no local fallback).

maria: auditability: emit append-only audit records for every fanout action: `{action, actor, affected_ingest_ids, before, after, trace_id}`. include event_version for rollout safety.

jamie: I'll draft proto + migration and a replay harness to validate dedupe semantics.

sre-bot: WARNING: 72h persistent marker store estimated +~18GB/month. see cost doc.

maria: noted 1 we'll include cost bakeoffs.

raj: ledger conflict policy: latest-ingest_ts-wins; increment discrepancy metric and open manual review if above threshold.

oliver: optimization later: bloom filter fronting and compaction to reduce marker writes for heavy tenants. start simple first.

maria: ops checklist before merge: lock schema, implement marker store, add SLO dashboards, audit topic + queries, tenant opt-in for extended TTL, proto + rollout plan.

jamie: tagging PR plan: proto by EOD tomorrow, will tag channel and request 30m walkthrough after PR. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks all. closing loop.
